name: Layla
notes: Both sources: 4pc Tenacity of the Millelith as the shield build's best, HP% on sands, goblet and circlet, Key of Khaj-Nisut first, Skill > Burst > Normal Attack. The sub-DPS builds in Game8 use Blizzard Strayer and Emblem of Severed Fate with Cryo DMG goblet, CRIT circlet and Primordial Jade Cutter; KQM lists Blizzard Strayer, Emblem, Noblesse Oblige, Instructor, Deepwood Memories and (as 'Voroukasha', a typo for Vourukasha's Glow) a shield-strength set. ER 130 is Game8's 'about 130' and KQM's double Cryo range (120-140 before C2). All of her damage and shield multiply Max HP (the kit's 'check' lines are small HP-scaling hits), so the scaling stat is HP. Neither source gives numeric goals beyond ER.
